import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile, textwrap
here = os.getcwd()
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
os.mkdir(os.path.join(d, "sub")); open(os.path.join(d, "sub", "marker_file_xyz"), "w").close()
code = textwrap.dedent("""
import sys; sys.path.insert(0, %r)
from app import run
for evil in ["x; touch PWNED1", "$(touch PWNED2)", "`touch PWNED3`", "x && touch PWNED4", "x | touch PWNED5", "x\\ntouch PWNED6"]:
    try: run(evil)
    except Exception: pass
r = run("sub")
print("RET:", r)
""") % here
r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", code], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
pw = [f for f in os.listdir(d) if f.startswith("PWNED")]
assert not pw, "command injection: %s" % pw
assert "marker_file_xyz" in r.stdout, "run('sub') no longer lists the directory: %r %r" % (r.stdout, r.stderr)
print("ok")

note: shell metacharacters in name no longer execute commands; run('sub') still lists the dir (stdout or return)
